rules.statement: An agreement under section 408 of the Civil Procedure Code must be notified to the Court by motion made in presence of, or on notice to, all parties concerned. The court is not obliged to enter a decree based on an agreement that was not properly presented.
rules.supporting_quote: "The agreement, compromise, or satisfaction shall be notified to Court by motion made in presence of, or on notice to, all parties concerned. This ruling was approved of by Jayewardene J. in Suppiah v. Abdulla [2 (1984) 26 N. L. R. 79.]"
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 408 of the Civil Procedure Code
